description: This Kotlin source file defines a fake implementation of the NewsRepository interface, which provides news resources data for testing purposes. It fetches data from a DemoNiaNetworkDataSource and applies filtering based on query parameters, primarily used for testing or mock setups within the Android project.

classes.name: FakeNewsRepository
classes.description: A mock implementation of the NewsRepository interface that provides fake news data for testing. It filters news resources based on query parameters and emits the filtered list as a Kotlin Flow.

methods.name: getNewsResources
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of NewsResource objects filtered according to the query parameters.

methods.name: syncWith
methods.description: Performs synchronization with a data source; in this implementation, it simply returns true.
